annotations.text: BFO core — the Basic Formal Ontology upper taxonomy (Arp, Smith & Spear 2015) as an EG theory. A *pure-ish T-box*: a deep subsumption spine (Object ⊑ MaterialEntity ⊑ IndependentContinuant ⊑ Continuant ⊑ Entity) with Continuant/Occurrent disjoint and the three dependence kinds pairwise disjoint. The case the *theorem query* is for — model-checking a subsumption over its sparse A-box reads vacuously; freezing a witness decides it. Complements SUMO as a second real upper ontology to test proposals against.

Imported from corpus/ontologies/bfo_core.ofn through the OWL→CLIF→EGI pipeline (26 CLIF axioms over 22 classes). Honest partial encoding: BFO's principal is-a spine + the three top disjointness axioms — a pure T-box, not the full BFO/RO axiomatisation. BFO's Relation-Ontology relations and any A-box are omitted from the stored UoD because relational scrolls are super-linear to lay out at the §3.3 save boundary while the taxonomy is cheap (the layout-perf frontier; M is data, draw only the contested fragment). Translator skips: none.
